course.title: GitHub — Complete Deep Developer Tools Course
course.description: A GitHub-specific, beginner-to-advanced course with detailed concepts, practical workflows, dedicated tasks, troubleshooting, security and a production learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn the tool properly; no fixed cross-tool template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Use the tool confidently in professional development.
Complete a production-style developer workflow capstone.

modules.title: GitHub Foundations
modules.description: Repositories, profiles, organizations, permissions and the relationship between Git and GitHub.

lessons.title: GitHub Foundations
lessons.description: Repositories, profiles, organizations, permissions and the relationship between Git and GitHub.
learningObjectives: Apply it to a realistic development workflow.

notes.text: Repositories, profiles, organizations, permissions and the relationship between Git and GitHub.
Learn github foundations by understanding the developer problem first, then the tool concept, then a realistic command/editor workflow, and finally how it fits into professional development.

GitHub Foundations is a practical part of a modern development workflow. Students should understand not only the command or editor feature, but also why it is used, what it changes, how to verify it and how to recover from mistakes.
